# ChunkReady

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h) · Described in `data/renderer.json`

The chunk's mesh was computed in a submitted compute batch and can be drawn.

## Notes

Emplaced by the Terrain system with ChunkGPU (the graphics submission of the frame waits on its compute), cleared in its destructor; storage created in its init so the passes can view it from worker threads. Read by the terrain and grass passes, RayScene, ChunkLayers and the debug menu.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: ChunkLayers, DebugMenu, RayScene, SoilMaps, grass, terrain. Written by: Terrain. Created by: Terrain. Destroyed by: Terrain.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | count of meshed chunks |
| [Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | init (storage), tick, destructor (clear) | set when the mesh is in this frame's compute submit: drawable |
| [ChunkLayers](../systems/service-ChunkLayers.md) | service | Host | **read** | update | Only chunks with a drawable mesh get a layer. |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **read** | updateChunks | Counts chunks pending. |
| [SoilMaps](../systems/service-SoilMaps.md) | service | Host | **read** | update (ChunkLayers::update) | Only chunks with a drawable mesh get a map. |
| [grass](../systems/pass-grass.md) | pass | Host | **read** | update (ChunkLayers::update), record | Drawable chunks get a height map and a draw. |
| [terrain](../systems/pass-terrain.md) | pass | Host | **read** | record | Only chunks whose mesh is drawable are drawn. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ChunkLayers](../systems/service-ChunkLayers.md)**
  - None of its own: the bake callback of its owner (SoilMaps, GrassPass) bakes and uploads.
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[SoilMaps](../systems/service-SoilMaps.md)**
  - GPU: one RGBA8 2D array image of up to 2048 layers (about 37 MB), a layer upload (Transfer::updateImage) per chunk baked; sets Context::soil_view and soil_sampler.
  - CPU: SoilField::bake on the main thread, at most 16 re-bakes a frame after a parameter change.
- **[Terrain](../systems/Terrain.md)**
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws when it is not 256 x 16 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv in init.
  - Allocates GPU memory: indirect buffer (2048 slots), staging ring (ring size x 8 chunks), lookup texel buffer, a 3 MB vertex buffer per slot (2^15 triangles x 3 vertices x 32 bytes, ray tracing usages when enabled), a readback buffer with ray tracing; descriptor pool and sets, compute pipeline.
  - Records into the compute command buffer of the frame: indirect resets, one dispatch per chunk, a clamp pass, with ray tracing copies of the indirect commands to the readback buffer; Tracy GPU zone "Marching cubes", CPU zone "Mesh chunks", plot "Chunks meshed".
  - Destroys the entities of chunks marked ChunkDestroying (all their components go with them).
  - Logs a warning "Terrain : out of chunk slots" when 2048 slots are used.
  - The destructor waits for the device to be idle and clears its components and TerrainBuffers.
- **[grass](../systems/pass-grass.md)**
  - Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/grass_raycast_<kind>.bin for the ten kinds of plants; uploads the ray textures (about 250 MB, less in blocks).
  - Uploads the species noise, a tile noise and the height map array.
  - Queues height map image updates for new chunks and up to 16 rebakes a frame after a parameter change.
  - Logs bake times and sizes; warns on an unknown grass_kind or an unwritable file.
  - Records up to three draws of each chunk's shell per target (stencil see through).
- **[terrain](../systems/pass-terrain.md)**
  - Reads resources/textures/grass.png, rock.jpg and resources/ground/ground.json with its textures, uploads them as texture arrays.
  - Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/ground_relief_{mud,stones,sand}.bin and uploads the relief rays.
  - Decodes the ground textures as taskflow tasks and waits for them in the constructor.
  - Logs a warning without ground textures, an info line per relief baked.
  - Records one indirect draw per ready chunk into each target's command buffer.
